title: Hilton Appoints Kolin Pound as Area President, Caribbean and Latin America
summary: Hilton announced the appointment of Kolin Pound as area president, Caribbean and Latin America (CALA), effective August 24, 2026.

Hospitality and investment executive to lead regional operations and support Hilton’s continued growth across the Caribbean and Latin America


- Hilton today announced the appointment of Kolin Pound as area president, Caribbean and Latin America (CALA), effective August 24, 2026.
- Pound will oversee Hilton’s operations across the region, leading hotel teams and partnering with owners and key stakeholders to drive performance, strengthen Hilton’s culture and support the company’s continued growth.
- Hilton currently welcomes travelers across the Caribbean and Latin America through a portfolio of 315 hotels and resorts across more than 35 countries and territories, with 150 additional hotels in development.


**MCLEAN, Va. and MIAMI, Fla.** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the appointment of Kolin Pound as area president, Caribbean and Latin America (CALA). In this role, Pound will oversee Hilton’s operations across the region, leading hotel teams and partnering with owners and key stakeholders to drive performance, strengthen Hilton’s culture and support the company’s continued growth. He joins from Ares Management, bringing extensive hospitality, real estate and investment experience across the Caribbean and Latin America. His appointment is effective August 24, 2026, and he will report to Danny Hughes, president, Americas, Hilton.


"Kolin is a strategic leader with a strong track record of driving performance, building trusted owner relationships and creating long-term value," said Danny Hughes, president, Americas, Hilton. "His deep understanding of hospitality, real estate and investment, combined with his experience across the Caribbean and Latin America, makes him exceptionally well positioned to lead our business in this dynamic region. As we continue to expand, Kolin’s leadership will help strengthen our momentum and deliver for our team members, owners, guests and communities."


"I am honored to join Hilton and work alongside its talented team members, owners and partners across the Caribbean and Latin America," said Pound. "The region is home to some of the world’s most attractive destinations, and I look forward to building on Hilton’s strong foundation to continue delivering exceptional performance, growing our portfolio and creating meaningful value for all our stakeholders."


> "I am honored to join Hilton and work alongside its talented team members, owners and partners across the Caribbean and Latin America. The region is home to some of the world’s most attractive destinations, and I look forward to building on Hilton’s strong foundation to continue delivering exceptional performance, growing our portfolio and creating meaningful value for all our stakeholders."
>
>
> Kolin Pound
>
>
> Area President, Caribbean and Latin America


As managing director at Ares Management, Pound partnered closely with leadership teams to support strategy, operational excellence and value creation across a diverse portfolio of businesses, including hospitality assets throughout the Caribbean and Latin America. Previously, he served as senior principal at Walton Street Capital, where he focused on asset management and acquisitions across real estate and hospitality. Throughout his career, Pound has led transactions across Latin America, the United States and Europe, developing extensive experience working with owners, operators and management teams to enhance asset performance and support long-term growth.


Pound holds a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Business Institutions from Northwestern University.


Hilton currently welcomes travelers across the Caribbean and Latin America through a portfolio of 315 hotels and resorts across more than 35 countries and territories. With 150 additional hotels in development, Hilton continues to expand its regional footprint across all segments with a focus in luxury, lifestyle, full-service, focused-service, resort and all-inclusive destinations.


Hilton prides itself in its award-winning culture globally and in the region, which is brought to life by more than 26,000 team members across the Caribbean and Latin America. In addition to being named the[No. 1 World’s Best Workplace](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-named-2025-no-1-worlds-best-workplace) , Hilton was recognized as the No. 1 Workplace in Latin America by Great Place to Work in 2026 and has been the top hospitality company to work for in the region for four consecutive years.

## About Hilton


Hilton (NYSE: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,400 properties and nearly 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 260 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
